tour.dashboard.title: Admin dashboard
tour.dataset.title: Manage dataset
tour.dataset.desc: Search, filter, review, and export dataset records.
tour.datasetCreate.title: Create records manually
tour.datasetCreate.desc: End-to-end flow for creating a dataset record from scratch.
tour.datasetReview.title: Review a record
tour.datasetReview.desc: Inspect OCR, annotations, validation, then decide.
tour.datasetExport.title: ML-ready export
tour.datasetExport.desc: Choose a profile, check integrity, generate an archive.
tour.detect.title: Allergen detection
tour.detect.desc: Upload a photo or paste ingredient text.
tour.users.title: Manage users
tour.users.desc: Roles, email verification, and account status.
tour.settings.title: Application settings
tour.settings.desc: Configuration that affects the whole application.
tour.profile.title: Profile & security
tour.step.dashboard.stats.title: Operational summary
tour.step.dashboard.stats.body: These four cards show product, allergen, user, and detection counts. Click a card to open its module.
tour.step.dashboard.trend.title: 14-day trend
tour.step.dashboard.trend.body: The chart shows workload, not decoration. Use it to decide when more reviewers are needed.
tour.step.dashboard.nav.title: Go to the dataset
tour.step.dashboard.nav.body: The Dataset menu is the curation hub. Click it to continue.
tour.step.dashboard.nav.hint: Click the “Dataset” menu in the sidebar.
tour.step.dashboard.guide.title: Guides are always available
tour.step.dashboard.guide.body: The help button at the top right opens the guide center. You can replay tours anytime without changing data.
tour.step.dataset.overview.title: Dataset health
tour.step.dataset.overview.body: These cards separate “awaiting review”, “export-ready”, and “needs correction”. Those are what you act on.
tour.step.dataset.search.title: Find a record
tour.step.dataset.search.body: Type a product name, brand, or label text snippet. Search runs server-side.
tour.step.dataset.search.hint: Type something in the search field.
tour.step.dataset.filter.title: Filter by status
tour.step.dataset.filter.body: Use the status filter to focus on the review queue or records needing correction.
tour.step.dataset.open.title: Open a record
tour.step.dataset.open.body: The “Open” button opens the review page: image, OCR, annotations, and validation in one place.
tour.step.dataset.export.title: Export the dataset
tour.step.dataset.export.body: Export produces a validated archive with manifest, splits, and checksums.
tour.step.create.identity.title: Product identity
tour.step.create.identity.body: Name, brand, and category are used for traceability and group-aware splitting.
tour.step.create.product.title: Enter the product name
tour.step.create.product.body: Product name is required when submitting for review. Drafts may leave it empty.
tour.step.create.ocr.title: Corrected text
tour.step.create.ocr.body: Paste or fix the label text here. This becomes the model input, separate from raw OCR.
tour.step.create.annotation.title: Allergen annotation
tour.step.create.annotation.body: Add allergens one by one and mark presence. Do not leave it empty for records that will be verified.
tour.step.create.save.title: Save draft
tour.step.create.save.body: Save a draft when data is incomplete. You can continue the review later.
tour.step.review.ocr.title: Inspect OCR
tour.step.review.ocr.body: Compare raw OCR with the human correction. Raw OCR is never overwritten — corrections are stored separately.
tour.step.review.allergens.title: Allergen annotations
tour.step.review.allergens.body: Check each allergen’s name, presence, severity, and text evidence.
tour.step.review.validation.title: Validation panel
tour.step.review.validation.body: Errors block verification; warnings need attention but do not always block. The backend remains authoritative.
tour.step.review.save.title: Save your decision
tour.step.review.save.body: Save changes before making a review decision.
tour.step.export.open.title: Open export
tour.step.export.open.body: Start from the dataset list; export uses the active filters.
tour.step.export.profile.title: Choose a profile
tour.step.export.profile.body: The profile defines the output structure. NLP for text, image for CNN, multimodal for both.
tour.step.export.preview.title: Preview selection
tour.step.export.preview.body: Preview computes eligible records, label distribution, splits, and integrity issues without creating files.
tour.step.export.generate.title: Generate archive
tour.step.export.generate.body: Export runs after preview passes. In simulation mode, the file is built in the browser.
tour.step.detect.model.title: Choose a model
tour.step.detect.model.body: BERT is most thorough, BiLSTM fastest, Ensemble combines both.
tour.step.detect.tab.title: Text tab
tour.step.detect.tab.body: No photo? Use the text tab to paste the ingredient list.
tour.step.detect.input.title: Enter ingredients
tour.step.detect.input.body: Paste the composition exactly as on the label, e.g. “wheat flour, milk, sugar”.
tour.step.detect.submit.title: Start checking
tour.step.detect.submit.body: Press the check button. Results are estimates, not a medical diagnosis.
tour.step.users.table.title: User list
tour.step.users.table.body: Search users, check email verification, and manage roles.
tour.step.users.verify.title: Verify users
tour.step.users.verify.body: Verification actions are admin-only and recorded by the backend.
tour.step.settings.form.title: Application settings
tour.step.settings.form.body: Changes here affect the whole app. Read each field description before saving.
tour.step.settings.save.title: Save settings
tour.step.settings.save.body: Save only when sure. In simulation mode, nothing actually changes.
tour.step.profile.form.title: Your profile
tour.step.profile.form.body: Update name, phone, and avatar. Email is managed through verification.
tour.step.profile.password.title: Account security
tour.step.profile.password.body: Use a strong password and change it if compromised.
tour.step.full.dashboard.title: Start at the dashboard
tour.step.full.dashboard.body: The dashboard gives a workload overview before diving into data.
tour.step.full.nav.title: Open the dataset
tour.step.full.nav.body: Click the Dataset menu to see the curation queue.
tour.step.full.dataset.title: Monitor quality
tour.step.full.dataset.body: Watch the counts for correction and export readiness.
tour.step.full.create.title: Create a record
tour.step.full.create.body: Admins can create records without waiting for user scans.
tour.step.full.export.title: ML-ready export
tour.step.full.export.body: Export uses reproducible profiles and splits.
tour.step.full.detect.title: Try the user flow
tour.step.full.detect.body: The main menu takes you to the detection page users see.
tour.step.full.detectPage.title: Detection page
tour.step.full.detectPage.body: This is where users upload photos or paste text. The full tour is complete.
dataset.contribute.title: Contribute to the dataset
dataset.contribute.desc: Help improve the model by submitting label corrections. An admin reviews it before use.
dataset.contribute.thanks: Thank you. Your contribution is queued for admin review.
tour.products.title: Products
tour.products.desc: Product catalog used by detection and dataset.
tour.step.products.table.title: Product table
tour.step.products.table.body: Search products, check category/brand, and open details. Products may be linked to dataset records.
tour.step.products.usage.title: Link to the dataset
tour.step.products.usage.body: Clean product data makes provenance easier. Use the Dataset menu to see related records.
tour.categories.title: Categories
tour.step.categories.table.title: Manage categories
tour.step.categories.table.body: Consistent categories make dataset filters and reports useful. Avoid duplicate names.
tour.allergens.title: Allergen master
tour.step.allergens.table.title: Canonical allergens
tour.step.allergens.table.body: Dataset annotations only accept names from this list. Add new allergens here before use.
tour.detections.title: Detections
tour.step.detections.table.title: Monitor detections
tour.step.detections.table.body: Use this table to find detections worth promoting to the dataset.
tour.cms.title: Content
tour.step.cms.table.title: Manage content
tour.step.cms.table.body: Clear content reduces confusion about what detection results mean.
tour.history.title: Detection history
tour.step.history.table.title: Your history
tour.step.history.table.body: Open details to see OCR, allergens, and confidence. History only shows your own data.
tour.step.history.contribute.title: Help the dataset
tour.step.history.contribute.body: In detection detail, use “Contribute” to submit text corrections. An admin reviews it before use.
